32/S0.subgoal: Explain why usable XR systems require a user-centered, systematic approach and introduce the software development lifecycle as that approach.

32/S1.subgoal: Explain why a structured lifecycle is needed by showing that a calendar application has a large interface design space.

32/S2.subgoal: Explain why interactive system development requires an iterative lifecycle and describe the main stages and iteration points of that lifecycle.

32/S3.subgoal: Explain the requirement-gathering stage and the design-prototype-evaluate loop for refining early interface and interaction designs.

32/S4.subgoal: Describe the code design, coding/testing, and empirical usability study stages and how they ensure an executable and usable system.

32/S5.subgoal: Explain why iterative loops other than the design-prototype-evaluate loop should be minimized to control cost and turnaround time.

32/S6.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture and preview the case-study-based discussion of the interactive system development stages.
